description:
Play Spiderette directly in ChatGPT with flexible suit and difficulty settings.

Choose from four suit options and four difficulty levels — Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert — to match the challenge you want.

Use the sidebar to choose your suit and difficulty, or simply tell ChatGPT what you want to play. Start an easy game, increase the difficulty, switch suit options, or begin a new challenge through conversation.

Features:

- Four suit options
- Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulty levels
- Quick suit and difficulty selection from the sidebar
- Conversational controls for changing game settings

Choose your challenge and start playing.
